svg.title: Figure 3.4. Entity-Relationship Diagram of METRICAST
svg.desc: A complete ERD for the current METRICAST Prisma PostgreSQL schema, including POS imports, transactions, products, payments, feedback, forecasts, finance settings, users, tokens, audit logs, and import errors.
svg.text: Complete implemented Prisma/PostgreSQL schema — PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, UQ = unique

g.text: IDX entityType, entityId · actorId, createdAt · createdAt
UQ transactionId, sourceRow · IDX paymentMethod, transactionId, importBatchId
UQ transactionId, sourceRow · IDX productId, transactionId, importBatchId

svg.text: Relationship and schema notes verified from Prisma
• TransactionItem → Transaction, TransactionItem → Product, and Payment → Transaction use onDelete: Restrict.
• Transaction → Customer and transaction/item/payment → ImportBatch are optional provenance links using onDelete: SetNull.
• RefreshToken, PasswordResetToken, CustomerFeedbackRating, and ImportError cascade when their owning User / Feedback Import / Import Batch is deleted, as declared in the schema.
• Customer feedback has no foreign key to Customer or Transaction. Forecast and FinancialSetting have no declared foreign-key relationship in the schema.
• Enums: UserRole = ADMINISTRATOR | MANAGER | STAFF; ImportStatus = IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | FAILED; ForecastGranularity = DAILY | WEEKLY | MONTHLY.
• No dedicated KPI entity/table exists. Dashboard and analytics KPIs are calculated from persisted operational and feedback data.
Cardinality notation: 1 = exactly one; 0..1 = optional one; 0..* = zero or many. Relationships are shown only where Prisma declares a relation.
